## Ravenous Hunter (CR 1)

Half-elf inquisitor 1 (Ravener Hunter, Sanctified Slayer)  
NG Medium humanoid (elf, human)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision, Perception +9  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+2 armor, +2 Dex, +1 shield)  
**hp** 9 (1d8+1)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +2, **Will** +5. +2 racial bonus vs. enchantment spells and effects; **Immune** sleep  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bastard sword +1 (1d10, 19-20)  
**Ranged** light crossbow +2 (1d8, 19-20)  
**Special Attacks** channel positive energy 3/day (1d6, DC 12), studied target +1  
**Inquisitor Spells Known** (CL 1st; concentration +4)  


1st Level (2/day)—protection from evil, reveal secrets (DC 14)  

0-Level (At will)—daze (DC 14), detect magic, guidance, read magic, stabilize  


Mystery Life  


**Statistics**
